RUNEPRIEST-IMBUED_TEACUP.title: Imbued Teacup
RUNEPRIEST-IMBUED_TEACUP.description: The first rune you [gold]Inscribe[/gold] each turn has its values doubled.
RUNEPRIEST-IMBUED_TEACUP.flavor: Steeped so long the leaves began to hum.
RUNEPRIEST-ENCHANTED_ANVIL.title: Enchanted Anvil
RUNEPRIEST-ENCHANTED_ANVIL.description: Whenever you [gold]Inscribe[/gold], deal {Damage} damage to ALL enemies.
RUNEPRIEST-ENCHANTED_ANVIL.flavor: Every stroke rings like a hammer blow.
RUNEPRIEST-BAPTISED_IDOL.title: Baptised Idol
RUNEPRIEST-BAPTISED_IDOL.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] {Cards} random cards that [gold]Inscribe[/gold] runes.
RUNEPRIEST-MIDAS_HAND.title: Midas Hand
RUNEPRIEST-MIDAS_HAND.flavor: It writes in a very expensive ink.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNIC_SPHERE.title: Runic Sphere
RUNEPRIEST-RUNIC_SPHERE.description: Cards with Rune in their name have [gold]Retain[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-HOLY_SPARKLER.title: Holy Sparkler
RUNEPRIEST-HOLY_SPARKLER.flavor: Every misfire still makes a pretty light.
RUNEPRIEST-BLESSED_TOOLBOX.title: Blessed Toolbox
RUNEPRIEST-BLESSED_TOOLBOX.description: Upon pickup, add a random Common card with Rune in its name to your deck. The first time you play a rune card each combat, draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
RUNEPRIEST-BLESSED_TOOLBOX.flavor: Every chisel inside has been blessed. Twice, to be safe.
RUNEPRIEST-AETHER_INKWELL.title: Aether Inkwell
RUNEPRIEST-AETHER_INKWELL.description: Upon pickup, obtain an [gold]Aether Quill[/gold] potion.
RUNEPRIEST-AETHER_INKWELL.flavor: The ink never dries, and neither do the runes it writes.
RUNEPRIEST-ANCHOR_SCROLL.title: Anchor Scroll
RUNEPRIEST-EXECUTION_SCROLL.title: Execution Scroll
RUNEPRIEST-EXECUTION_SCROLL.description: At the start of combat, [gold]Inscribe[/gold] [blue]Execution[/blue] and [blue]Strike[/blue] {Strike}.
RUNEPRIEST-EXECUTION_SCROLL.flavor: The sentence is written before the trial begins.
RUNEPRIEST-HEALERS_SCROLL.title: Healer's Scroll
RUNEPRIEST-HEALERS_SCROLL.description: The first time each combat you [gold]Inscribe[/gold] a [blue]Blood[/blue] rune, [gold]Inscribe[/gold] [blue]Mend[/blue] equal to the Blood amount.
RUNEPRIEST-DE_ILLUMINATOR.title: De-illuminator
RUNEPRIEST-DE_ILLUMINATOR.description: The first [blue]Void[/blue] you [gold]Inscribe[/gold] each combat immediately [gold]Fizzles[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-DE_ILLUMINATOR.flavor: It un-writes the darkness before the darkness can un-write you.
RUNEPRIEST-UNDEAD_QUILL.title: Undead Quill
RUNEPRIEST-UNDEAD_QUILL.flavor: It drains the writer and signs for the dead.
RUNEPRIEST-LIGHTWEIGHT_CLOTH_ROBE.title: Lightweight Cloth Robe
RUNEPRIEST-LIGHTWEIGHT_CLOTH_ROBE.descri: Cards with [blue]Blood[/blue] runes cost 0. Your [blue]Blood[/blue] runes are doubled.
RUNEPRIEST-LIGHTWEIGHT_CLOTH_ROBE.flavor: Light enough to dodge, heavy enough to hurt.
RUNEPRIEST-CORRUPTED_SIGIL.title: Corrupted Sigil
RUNEPRIEST-CORRUPTED_SIGIL.description: Upon pickup, remove every [gold]Eternal Sigil[/gold] from your deck and add a [gold]Corrupted Sigil[/gold] to it.
RUNEPRIEST-ASCENDED_TOOLBOX.title: Ascended Toolbox
RUNEPRIEST-ASCENDED_TOOLBOX.description: Whenever you play a card with Rune in its name, draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
RUNEPRIEST-ASCENDED_TOOLBOX.flavor: Orobas laid a single finger on the lid. The chisels have not stopped humming since.
RUNEPRIEST-DARK_TABLET.title: Dark Tablet
RUNEPRIEST-DARK_TABLET.description: Your [blue]Blood[/blue] runes damage enemies and your [blue]Mend[/blue] runes heal enemies instead of you.
RUNEPRIEST-DARK_TABLET.flavor: Its inscriptions read the same in both directions, and mean the opposite in each.
RUNEPRIEST-EVENT_HORIZON.title: Event Horizon
RUNEPRIEST-EVENT_HORIZON.description: Your [blue]Void[/blue] runes [gold]Persist[/gold]. Whenever one of your [blue]Void[/blue] runes consumes a rune, deal damage equal to that rune's value to ALL enemies.
RUNEPRIEST-EVENT_HORIZON.flavor: Vakuu folds a dying star into your palm. It is still hungry.
RUNEPRIEST-ETERNAL_CANDLE.title: Eternal Candle
RUNEPRIEST-ETERNAL_CANDLE.description: Upon pickup, add an [gold]Eternal Scroll[/gold] to your deck. At rest sites, you may [gold]Etch[/gold] a rune card onto it.
RUNEPRIEST-ETERNAL_CANDLE.flavor: Tezcatara's flame does not consume the wax. It consumes the hours.
RUNEPRIEST-CURSED_RING.title: Cursed Ring
RUNEPRIEST-CURSED_RING.flavor: Its last owner never asked for it back.
